evidence.summary: Measured 20.6 MB and 19.7 MB of stored gzip snapshots per run: about 0.95 GB/day, about 29 GB/month in cip, and about 4.2k Evetech page downloads a day at the D-0061 cadence. No paid service or new dependency.

rationale: Storage growth is unbounded and material for a local Postgres; needs a decision (snapshot-on-change/failure, retention, or per-site interval) before polling runs for long. Recorded as finding.defer; stopgap is removing the two worker flags.
